analysis:
This batch contains only added test files for a new add-on hold feature. No production source was supplied, so the security conclusions below are coverage-limited.

Files examined:
- AddonCommandTests.swift
- AddonHoldLoopTests.swift
- AddonHoldServeLoopTests.swift
- AddonHoldStoreTests.swift
- AddonIPCServerTests.swift (metadata only; its source was not supplied).

New attack surface inferred from the tests:
1) A Unix socket at <install>/runtime/addon.sock. Peers are authenticated by code-signing requirement. AddonHoldStoreTests.swift:121 shows the requirement as an anchor apple generic Developer ID for io.darkbloom.sandbox, team SLDQ2GJ6TL.
2) DEBUG builds accept an extra identity from the AddonPeerPolicy.developmentIdentityVariable environment variable (lines 139-151). Integration must verify this is compiled out of release builds; otherwise any local signer could pass by setting the environment variable.
3) AddonHoldPaths.socketOverrideVariable relocates the socket, lock and hold record (lines 107-111). The test calls it test-only, but it appears reachable in production via AddonHoldPaths.production(environment:). Integration must verify a production build ignores it or that it cannot weaken peer authentication.
4) Hold state is persisted in addon-hold.json with mode 0600 in a 0700 directory; symlinks and loose modes are rejected (lines 56-81).
5) The machine lock is ownership.lock, probed with flock. An expired lease persists while the lock is held (AddonHoldLoopTests.swift:245-268). Any same-user process able to flock that file can keep the provider out of routing indefinitely. This is a local availability effect only (TB-003, operator-controlled), so it was not flagged.
6) Holds are scoped per peer identity: another peer gets unauthorized/notFound (lines 153-157).
7) While held, the provider sends draining heartbeats and returns 503/draining for routed requests. The busy fields are added to register/heartbeat messages on the coordinator wire (TB-002). The App Attest worker is untouched (line 133).
8) The hold unloads all models; a release replays deferred desired models.

No regression is observable from tests alone. Integration must check:
- AddonIPCServer audit-token authentication, including the use of the peer's audit token rather than its PID.
- Bounds on JSON request size and timeouts.
- Whether the socket override and the development identity are disabled in release builds.
- That the busy and draining states do not affect App Attest authorization semantics (TB-011, T-053).
